about_the_game:
A virtual pet device in the corner of your screen! Feed and play with your pet while you work or play for dopamine boosts that makes even mundane tasks a little more fun!

As you feed and play with your pets, their stats will improve, allowing them to evolve. Meticulously fill out your encyclopedia or just explore and find your favorites! 

Features of this game include:

  • A minimizable display, to keep the game out of your way while you work

  • A wide variety of pets to discover and play with

  • A series of minigames that scale in difficulty with your pet

  • An optional productivity mode that slows down the game to keep you focused
